description: This script generates and writes a JSON catalog of official channels by scanning extension directories, extracting package metadata from package.json files, and assembling a catalog with channel information and installation details. It also includes a command-line trigger to generate the catalog file.

methods.name: buildOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Scans extension directories, reads package.json files, filters and constructs catalog entries based on specific openclaw and release metadata, and returns a sorted catalog object.

methods.name: writeOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Builds the catalog using buildOfficialChannelCatalog and writes it to the designated JSON file path, utilizing an external file-writing utility.
